summary: The agent home: what needs you, every agent's status and one action, and what happened since you last looked.
intent: Block: the home for a group of agents. Needs you (the oldest open request as one ApprovalCard, the rest counted), All agents (an icon-and-word status, one fact, cost and one action per row, under one filter) and a Since rail of what happened after the last visit. A Timeline view shows the same agents on one time axis on wide screens. Replaces AgentFleet, AgentLanes and the AgentInbox list.
useWhen: the first screen of an agent workspace
come back after a while and see what changed and what needs you
approve the open request, review a failed agent or ask a running one from one place

agents.note: { id, name, model?, icon?, status?, now?, cost?, subAgents? }[]. status is AgentStatus (queued | running | needs-you | paused | done | failed; older waiting and approval map to needs-you, idle to queued); default from the agent's latest event. now is one line on what it is doing. cost like "$0.42"; when every agent has one the lead line adds the total spent. subAgents { id, name, status, elapsed?, cost? }[] are counted on the row.

events.note: AgentLanes tasks plus action? (ApprovalCard action) and risk?: { id, agentId, title, status: "done" | "running" | "waiting" | "failed", start, end?, ask?, summary?, handoffTo?, action?, risk? }[]. Open waiting events fill Needs you, oldest first; events since `since` fill the Since rail.

since.note: Epoch ms of the last visit. The lead line and the Since rail start from it.

now.note: Controlled clock; else it ticks every second.

filter.note: Controlled filter for the All agents list and the Timeline lanes, by agent status.

view.note: Controlled view. timeline renders AgentLanes in place of the list; below --grid-breakpoint-sm (40rem) of block width only the list shows and the toggle hides.

onApprove.note: (eventId) => void. From the Needs you card or a lane block.

onReject.note: (eventId) => void. Deny on the Needs you card.

onRetry.note: (eventId) => void. Kept for older apps; the row action for a failed agent is Review (onReview).

onReview.note: (agentId) => void. Review on a failed agent's row.

onAsk.note: (agentId) => void. Ask on a running agent's row.

onNewTask.note: () => void. New task in the header: open TaskBrief.

layout: header: title and lead line (since time · agents, spent); the List / Timeline toggle and New task at the end
layout-split--primary: Needs you over All agents in the wide column, the Since rail (ActivityFeed history) in the narrow one

the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width it is one column in reading order: Needs you, All agents, Since rail; below --grid-breakpoint-sm (40rem) Timeline hides and the list shows

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
status is an icon plus the word: icons are aria-hidden, the word is visible text; the running icon stops under prefers-reduced-motion
Needs you is a section named "<agent> asks"; new requests are announced in a polite live region and focus never jumps to them
the filter is a kit SegmentedControl (radio group) named Show agents; each segment's name includes its count
row actions are kit Buttons from ListView (Review, Ask); the Since rail is ActivityFeed history, an ordered list
no motion of its own besides the status spinner

doNot: Do not rebuild AgentOverview from a local dashboard; import the block
Do not repeat a request: it lives in Needs you only; the row and the rail point to it
Do not show status by colour alone; use the icon and the word
Do not add a second filter; the one filter drives the list and the lanes
Only one solid primary in the view: the approve in the Needs you card
snippet: <AgentOverview agents={agents} events={events} since={lastVisit} onApprove={approve} onReject={deny} onReview={openRun} onAsk={askAgent} onNewTask={openBrief} />
